## Checklist (see rules/git-and-branches.md)

- [ ] Branch is named `type/short-name`
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] If a number or behaviour changed: `rules/rules.json` and the matching sheet in `rules/` both changed
- [ ] No generated file (`assets/`) edited by hand
- [ ] No secret in the change
